designationHistory.indexText: Navassa Island National Wildlife Refuge About Us Contact Us Visit Us Species Map About Us Established in 1999, Navassa Island National Wildlife Refuge is an uninhabited, 5 km² island in the Caribbean Sea between Haiti and Jamaica.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
